info.title: Codex app-server used boundary
info.description: Observed raw WebSocket RPC subset. The app-server wire format omits the JSON-RPC 2.0 version member; these are descriptive RPC entries, not a claim of strict JSON-RPC conformance.

methods.name: account/read

errors.message: Invalid Request or upstream-specific rejected request

methods.description: Read the current account/auth state without requesting token refresh. The owning agent maps only the resulting authorization state to its public enum; do not expose or log raw account, plan, or workspace-routing fields. Calling initialize does not establish account authorization.
methods.x-wire: read-only request/response; use refreshToken=false; does not perform login, refresh, logout, or token read

methods.name: account/rateLimits/read

errors.message: Invalid Request or upstream-specific rejected request

methods.description: Read usage windows. The agent sends excludeResetCreditDetails=true and never opts into supportsLunaReserve. The response may contain account, credit, and plan fields; the public agent exposes only the codex primary/secondary remaining percentages, duration, and reset timestamp.
methods.x-wire: read-only request/response; no account, plan, credit, or upsell data is exposed by the agent
